title: Big City
summary: Lillith starts, Rubella answers, Kenji spoken tag. Small Glamora club stage as A-roll; B-roll is inappropriately huge hair as architecture — skyline, fire-escape strands, lunch-volume dos, ELO afros in slow-motion argument. Product off-screen. Not the Ultra Screech ad. Imagine audio prompt is stems the same length as each clip, not the full 2:47.
visualArc: Kenji tag on stage → Lillith verse → fire-escape strand → pre-chorus lift → chorus hair-skyline → Rubella under the fringe / lunch dos → laundry look-through → Kenji solo hair-blocks → bridge on stage → stacked chorus intercut → Kenji tag again.
